# Local barcode decoder

zxing-browser-0.2.1.min.js is the unmodified UMD bundle from the official @zxing/browser0.2.1 npm tarball:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@zxing/browser/-/browser-0.2.1.tgz

Tarball SHA512 (verified before extracting the named files):
92pVfVDUXbc15xu9vIEmhNyqIEASMEkDF92CwT6T+7sg2EHXJRktH9CQKoQSXe51UtbNsj+Fm09H/JBWHMs/Sw==

Loaded lazily from this application only when scanning; no runtime CDN dependency. Camera and barcode-image decoding remain on the device. Only the validated GTIN is passed to RetroHQ's market endpoint. The bundle includes the ZXing library core. Browser MIT and core Apache2.0 licences/notices are in ZXING-LICENSE.txt. Repository: https://github.com/zxing-js/browser . Do not edit the minified bundle; update the pinned package and provenance together.
